mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the CPIAUCSL below 243.8 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, as perceived inflationary pressures prompt market anticipation of future rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 243.8 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal occurs without a subsequent rate cut within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS rates and a decline in UNRATE signals tightening labor markets and higher borrowing costs, paradoxically boosting equity valuations through risk-on asset flows over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in 60% of triggered instances (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the effect reverses during periods of sustained rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below its 2017=100 baseline indicates weakening supply-side growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a late-cycle expansion.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the supply contraction, or the effect persists beyond the contraction period without a subsequent recovery in production.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST above 1300 signals robust manufacturing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not exceed baseline by 1% in 70% of triggered instances (p > 0.05), or the signal occurs without a subsequent sustained demand surge.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in PAYEMS above 145,970 indicate strong labor demand, compressing wage growth expectations and boosting equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline by 2% in 60% of periods with sustained high employment (p > 0.05), or the effect reverses during labor market tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and a decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals robust economic activity and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases while FEDFUNDS decreases in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction does not predict positive returns in 80% of triggered instances (p > 0.05), or the effect diminishes during periods of persistent rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in UNRATE above 4.5% in a monetary tightening cycle signals labor cost pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate inflationary risks.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the labor cost increase, or the effect reverses during periods of sustained rate cuts.
